question: Which Indian music composer received his second Grammy in the ‘Best New Age Album’ category for his 14th studio album ‘Divine Tides’, which he shared with American musician and composer Stewart Copeland at the 2022 Grammy Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ricky Kej**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ricky Kej is an Indian composer and environmentalist who has won multiple Grammy Awards.
 
• He received his second Grammy in the 'Best New Age Album' category for his 14th studio album 'Divine Tides' at the 2022 Grammy Awards.
 
• 'Divine Tides' is a collaborative album with American musician and composer Stewart Copeland, who is best known as the drummer for the band The Police.
 
• Ricky Kej's music often focuses on themes of environmental conservation and raising awareness about global issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grammy Awards**

 
 
• The Grammy Awards, or Grammys, are awards presented by the Recording Academy to recognize achievements in the music industry.
 
• They are considered one of the most prestigious awards in the music industry, covering various genres and categories.
 
• The awards are presented annually, and the ceremony includes performances by prominent artists.
 
• The 'Best New Age Album' category recognizes excellence in albums that fall within the New Age music genre.
 
 
 
• **Stewart Copeland**
 
 
• Stewart Copeland is an American musician and composer, best known as the drummer for the rock band The Police.
 
• He has also composed music for film, television, and video games.
 
• Copeland has been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of The Police.
 
• His collaboration with Ricky Kej on 'Divine Tides' brought together their diverse musical backgrounds to create a unique album.
 
 
 
• **New Age Music**
 
 
• New Age music is a genre of music intended to create artistic inspiration, relaxation, and optimism.
 
• It is often used for yoga, meditation, and massage therapy, or as a method of stress management.
 
• The genre includes both acoustic forms with instruments such as flutes, piano, and guitar, and electronic forms using synthesizers and other digital instruments.
 
• New Age music is characterized by its tranquil, soothing, and meditative qualities.
